title: PricingPolicy
description: The manager's standing instructions for one SKU. Published to retail/guardrail/{product_id} by dashboard-api when a manager edits them. QoS 1, retained. This is not merely a clamp — it is the automation policy that decides which agent proposals apply without a human and which wait for one. It is the mechanism by which a manager delegates authority, so it is load-bearing, not advisory.

min_price.description: Floor. A proposal below this is never auto-applied and is flagged as out-of-band in the review queue. The agent should clamp its own proposals to this range.

max_price.description: Ceiling. Must be >= min_price; dashboard-api rejects the edit otherwise.

auto_approve_pct.description: Maximum price move, as a percentage of the current price, that may be applied without a human. NULL means always ask — every proposal for this SKU goes to the review queue regardless of size. 0 has the same practical effect but states it as a threshold rather than as a policy choice; prefer NULL for 'always ask'.

set_by.description: Username of the manager who set the policy. Feeds the audit log.
